answer: The 1-50 patients group is the patient volume group in which healthcare workers show a statistically significant difference (p<0.05) in COVID-19 severity between the BCG vaccination and placebo groups based on chi-square analysis (event-level chi-square without continuity correction: χ²=4.80, df=1, p=0.0285; corroborated by Fisher's exact p=0.034). Caveats: this significance depends on the event-level severity definition without continuity correction (Yates-corrected p=0.051 is borderline; the subject-level max-severity analysis is non-significant, p=0.208), while the 51-100 and >100 patient-volume groups are underpowered and untestable (expected cell counts <5; no significant differences under any variant).
